scientific_integrity: Originality is assessed at best knowledge; an older equivalent polynomial-phase ambiguity classification remains possible. Finite exhaustive tests support a separate analytic all-prime argument; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only primes at least five, and lengths p and p squared. This is linear operator-span rank, not a general nonlinear phase-retrieval or noise-stability claim. Positive eigenvalues are presented as explicit finite character sums rather than consolidated multiplicity classes.
title: Arithmetic half-rank collapse for quartic cyclic Gabor projectors
